links.outcome: Board-exam accuracy of curated-evidence-grounded system vs web-retrieval frontier LLMs
links.effect: Mirror 87.5% (105/120) vs GPT-5.2 74.6%, GPT-5 74.0%, Gemini-3-Pro 69.8%; human reference 62.3%.
links.quote: Curated evidence with explicit provenance can outperform unconstrained web retrieval for subspecialty clinical reasoning and supports auditability for clinical deployment.

links.outcome: Citation accuracy and guideline-tier source citation rate in outputs on manual verification
links.effect: 74.2% of outputs cited at least one guideline-tier source, with 100% citation accuracy on manual verification.
links.quote: Mirror provided evidence traceability: 74.2% of outputs cited at least one guideline-tier source, with 100% citation accuracy on manual verification.

screen.reason: Evaluates a specialized model/reasoning architecture (January Mirror) against general frontier LLMs on a medical board examination benchmark without testing a health system deployment practice or guardrail.
